BETWEEN:-
 CHANDRABHAN BAGHEL S/O SHRI NEWARAM
BAGHEL, AGED 25 YEARS, R/O GRAM SHANKARGAD

P.S. AMOLA DISTRICT SHIVPURI (MADHYA PRADESH)
 
 (SHRI AKHAND PRATAP SINGH- ADVOCATE)

AND  STATE OF MADHYA PRADESH THROUGH POLICE  STATION AMOLA DISTRICT SHIVPURI (MADHYA  PRADESH)
 ..
 (SHRI SUSHANT TIWARI - PUBLIC PROSECUTOR)

This application coming on for admission this day, the   following:
 ORDER This second bail application has been filed by applicant under section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 for grant of bail in connection with Crime No.272/2022 registered at Police Station Amola, District Shivpuri for the offence punishable under Sections 304B, 498A/34 of IPC and 3/4 of Dowry Prohibition Act.
The applicant is in judicial custody since 08.01.2023.

First bail application was dismissed as withdrawn by Coordinate Bench of this Court vide order dated 20.03.2023 passed in MCRC No.12231/2023, with liberty to file afresh in the week commencing 3rd July, 2023 or after the statement of parents of the deceased are recorded before the trial Court, whichever is earlier.
A s per the case of prosecution, Seema Baghel married to applicant/accused Chandrabhan on 04.05.2019.
They are blessed with one son.
The applicant started demanding dowry of Rs.1,00,000/- and harassing his wife Seema.
Due to constant harassment of applicant and his mother Kusum, Seema committed suicide on 02.12.2022.

1 registered FIR in Crime No.272 of 2022 for offence punishable under Sections 304B, 498A/34 of IPC and 3/4 of Dowry Prohibition Act against the applicant and his mother.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Co-accused Kusum was granted bail vide order dated 01.02.2023 passed in MCRC No.4337 of 2023.
On completion of investigation, charge sheet was filed.
The trial is underway.
Learned counsel for the applicant in addition to the grounds mentioned in the application, submits that the applicant has falsely been implicated i n the matter.
The family members of deceased made allegation against the applicant in the heat of moment.
He has never harassed the deceased for dowry.

Evidence of Vidhya Ram (father of deceased), Kamlesh (mother of deceased), Arvind (brother of deceased), Diwan Singh and Janved (independent witnesses) has been recorded in the trial, none of the witnesses has supported the allegation with regard to demand of dowry.
Applicant is resident of village Shankargad, Police Station Amola, District Shivpuri.
There is no likelihood of his absconsion leaving behind his mother, minor child and the property.
There is no likelihood of tampering with the evidence.
Jail incarceration is causing great hardship to the applicant.
The trial would take time to complete.
Therefore, applicant may be extended the benefit of bail.
Per contra, learned counsel for the State, opposes the bail application on the ground of gravity of alleged offence.
Heard learned learned counsel for the parties and perused the case diary.
Considering the arguments advanced by both the parties and overall circumstances of the case, but without commencing on merits of the case, this Court inclined to grant bail to the applicant.
Thus, the application is allowed.

sentences.text:
The applicant shall ensure due compliance of provisions of Section 309 of Cr.P.C regarding examination of witness in attendance;
This order shall be effective till the end of trial.
However, in case of breach of any of the pre-condition of bail, it shall become ineffective without reference to the Court.
CC as per rules.

(SANJEEV S KALGAONKAR) JUDGE Avi Chandrabhan Baghel vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 19 September, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/148952620/
